data.text: Two things the real publish taught, both now in DOC-64. First: npm run reference must come after publishing, not before - prepublishOnly rebuilds and the build wipes dist, so a reference.json made beforehand is gone by the time the tarball is cut. Its absence from the package is correct (DEC-4: the package ships the generator, not the generated file), and my own npm pack --dry-run that showed it was reading a stale dist. Second: publishing the checklist as a document moved the relevance test from 0.68 to 0.64, level with its own floor - a page of release vocabulary shifts the rarity of a dozen words. The floor is now two questions lower so that a build breaks on a ranking change rather than on a new document.
